note: Changes that are finished but are waiting for the next card update, because sending one costs a signed update to every card in a customer's home. Run "npm run firmware:waiting" to read this, and "npm run firmware:release" to carry it all at once.

waiting.what: Stop the card repeating an old 'update rolled back' record after a different build has been installed.
waiting.why: Studio already ignores the stale record (build 2476), so this is not worth a signed card update on its own; it passed its host test and compiles, but has not been bench-tested on a card.

waiting.what: Store the staged wiring candidate in a second project slot and confirm a wiring change by flipping which slot is live, so the card never needs room for another project copy.
waiting.why: Every rewire on a card holding a full project answered candidate storage failed or candidate confirmation failed; on the bench card this build staged and confirmed 5 of 5 changes, including the blank-card Find my strips install.
